Tertiary (ensino superior) enrollment — multi-source compilation

Source: R/data.R
enrollment_tertiary.Rd

National-level (BR) Brazilian higher-education enrollment from 1907 to 2024, harmonised across official records and academic compilations. The dataset is consumed by get_enrollment() when level = "superior". Multiple sources for the same (year, network) are kept on purpose so users can compare competing estimates — pass source = "..." to lock in a specific series.

Usage

enrollment_tertiary

Format

A tibble with 1 143 rows and 16 columns matching the canonical schema (inst/dict/schema.yaml). The tertiary-specific columns are:

level

Always "superior".

network

Administrative dependency: federal, estadual, municipal, publica, privada, plus the private sub-categories (privada_particular / privada_comunitaria_confessional_filantropica pre-2009, privada_lucrativa / privada_nao_lucrativa post-2009), especial, total. especial (INEP category "Especial", art. 242 CF; microdata 2012-2024) is an "of which" breakdown of municipal, following INEP's own classification.

institution_type

INEP/MEC institutional category: university, university_center, faculty, faculty_school_institute, integrated_faculty, integrated_faculty_university_center, technology_center, technology_center_fat, cefet_ifet, isolated_establishment, total.

modality

presencial, ead, or total (available from 2000 onwards).

is_derived

TRUE when the row is a reconstructed total — a computed total combining the in-person enrollment from one source with the EAD enrollment from INEP, used to fix the 2000-2008 transition gap where the original sources excluded EAD from their nominal totals. Filtered out by get_enrollment() unless include_derived = TRUE.

Source

Compilation curated by the package author (Mançano, 2026) from publicly available sources. Raw file: data-raw/sources/tertiary_multisource/data_tertiary_v6_clean.xlsx. ETL: data-raw/03_build_enrollment_tertiary.R.

Primary sources

  • ibge_seculo_xx — Anuários Estatísticos 1908-1980.

  • maduro_junior_2007 — Maduro Junior MSc dissertation.

  • kang_paese_felix_2021 — only as the in-person component of derived rows; the Kang series itself is in enrollment_kang_fgv.

  • inep_sinopse_censup — INEP Sinopse 1995-2008.

  • inep_microdados_censup — INEP microdata 2009-2024. The INEP Power BI panel, bundled until 0.1.1, was dropped in 0.1.2 because every cell equals this aggregation.

For derived rows the source column is the concatenation "<presencial_key>+<ead_key>"; the exact composition is documented in source_note.

Português

Matrículas no ensino superior: 1.143 linhas, Brasil, 1907–2024. Prefira get_enrollment() com level = "superior". network registra rede e subcategorias privadas antes/depois de 2009; institution_type registra organização acadêmica; modality distingue presencial, EAD e total. A categoria especial (2012–2024) é um subconjunto da municipal, não uma parcela a ser somada novamente. Fontes: IBGE Século XX, Maduro Junior (2007), INEP Sinopses (1995–2008, incluindo 2002) e Microdados (2009–2024). Kang entra como componente presencial de totais derivados. is_derived marca totais reconstruídos (presencial + EAD, 2000–2008), excluídos por padrão; source combina as chaves das fontes e source_note detalha a composição. O painel Power BI do INEP foi retirado por duplicar os microdados. ETL: data-raw/03_build_enrollment_tertiary.R.

Colunas: year é o ano; geo_level, geo_code e geo_name identificam nível, código e nome geográficos; indicator, value e unit registram indicador, valor e unidade; source é a chave de fonte e source_note a nota bibliográfica. Dimensões usam "total" para agregados, preservando NA para informação desconhecida. Os dados mantêm identificadores canônicos; consulte a função pública com lang = "pt" para traduzir rótulos.
